name: cli
// targets: build (inferred from webpack.config.js) writes dist/apps/cli/taleart.js, one executable file with a #!/usr/bin/env node line, and its package.json (bin taleart), with the agent skill (skills/taleart, @taleart/agent-skill) bundled as text for `taleart skill install`. test runs the unit tests and src/cli.integration.spec.ts, which starts the built API on a free port and a database derived from TEST_DATABASE_URL (<name>_cli_test, dropped and created) and runs the built CLI against it; src/skill.spec.ts checks every command and flag the skill and the docs AI agents page name against the CLI.
